defects.detail: Bottom-right box reads 'Ref. Dwg. TJC-LLD-PID-XXXX'; the datasheet, GA drawing and C&E cross-reference this sheet as TJC-LLD-PID-1201.

Legend first row 'LOGIC' is followed by an illegible italic word; the inset repeats 'API PLAN 11 + PLAN 62' as 'API PLAN II + PLAN 62'; 'TT-1201 (Bearing Temp Temp)'; motor ID printed 'EQ1000012011-' with a trailing hyphen.

FIT-1201 tags both a bubble and the valve symbol in the discharge header; both pump discharge valves are tagged XV-1201A/B while C&E EFF-2 names XV-1201 and the drawn suction valve is XV-1201; PSLL-1201 is drawn twice (suction line element and pump-A bubble).

No title block: the sheet carries only the Ref. Dwg. box and the equipment label GA-1201A. C&E permissive 3 'Min-flow valve OPEN ZSO-1202', permissive 4 'DCS reset', initiator T5 MPR-1201 and effect EFF-5 'START STANDBY PUMP GA-1201B' are not drawn.
